The '''Blood of Talath''' were a group of criminal [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] known for their violent behavior that operated by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were one of many prisoners that were imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] where they were placed in the secret [[Project Noble Focus]] initiative. They were eventually freed from captivity by an attack by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] that resulted in a planet-scale riot. This saw the Blood of Talath killing the various alien species while under the command of their leader [[Sulkhaz]] and actively engaged the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] forces on the planet.
